title: Magnolia Cottages Mermaids of Magnolia Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Mermaids of Magnolia, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart Included, Pet Friendly, 4 Bikes
description_expanded: Description Description 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Mermaids of Magnolia, located in Seacrest, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart Included, Pet Friendly, 4 Bikes Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! FEATURES* Golf Cart Included - 6 Seater* Pet Friendly* Large Screened In Porch with Plenty of Seating and Grill * Open Living Area - 65" Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 65" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 65" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 65" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 4 - 2 Bunk Beds (4 Full Beds), 65" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom* Half Bathroom on Main Level* Outdoor Shower* Full Size Washer and Dryer* Seacrest Beach - Neighboring Rosemary and Alys Beach* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 14 30A Beach Access Points About 30A Magnolia Cottages by the Sea - Seacrest, FloridaMagnolia Cottages by the Sea, nestled along the renowned 30A, stands out as a cherished family retreat for those seeking an unforgettable vacation experience. Situated in the scenic Seacrest Beach, Florida, this new section of Magnolia Cottages introduces a perfect blend of coastal living and modern amenities. One of its prime features is the convenient Beach Access at Gulf Lakes, providing guests with easy and direct entry to the pristine shores that have made 30A famous. Beyond the sun-kissed beaches, a resort-style pool awaits, nestled seamlessly within the natural wooded beauty of the community. Here, guests find solace after a day of coastal adventures, immersing themselves in the serene surroundings that define the allure of Magnolia Cottages. The community's commitment to preserving its natural charm enhances the overall appeal, creating an atmosphere that invites relaxation and rejuvenation. Magnolia Cottages by the Sea promises an idyllic escape where families can forge lasting memories against the backdrop of this picturesque coastal haven. With its enticing Beach Access, resort-style pool, and the captivating natural setting, Magnolia Cottages emerges as the ideal accommodation for your next family beach vacation. This is not just a place to stay; it's a destination that encapsulates the essence of seaside living and offers an unparalleled retreat for those who appreciate the beauty of both land and sea. Community HighlightsResort Style Pool with Plenty of SeatingBeach Access - Gulf LakesNatural Preserve Feel with Plenty of ShadeWalk or Bike to Rosemary and Alys Beach1 Mile to The Big Chill Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome well-trained dogs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read less

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
Outdoor Spaces & Property Features: Beach Access-One Block to the Beach
